# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py from the registered tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool that `pipefy-mcp-server` registers, grouped by subject domain. The `remote` flag marks a tool that the remote profile serves. [`tools/`](tools/cross-cutting.md) explains the behavior that a docstring does not state.

## workflow

Running a process: pipes, phases, fields, labels, field conditions, cards, comments, card attachments, inbox email, and pipe/card relations.

### `add_card_comment`

Add a text comment to a Pipefy card.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `card_id` | `string` | required | The ID of the card to comment on |
| `text` | `string` | required | The comment text to post (1-1000 characters) |

### `create_attachment_presigned_url`

Mint a presigned S3 upload target for an attachment — no bytes uploaded.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | `string` | required | Pipefy organization id (numeric or uuid). Use ``get_organization`` or ``get_pipe`` to find it. |
| `file_name` | `string` | required | File name including extension; names the stored object. |
| `content_type` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional MIME type to sign into the upload. |

### `create_card`

Create a card in the pipe.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | The ID of the pipe where the card will be created. Discover via: ``search_pipes`` or ``get_organization``. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional card title. Passed on CreateCardInput when set. |
| `fields` | `object \| null` | `null` | A dictionary of fields that can be pre-filled on the card. When ``skip_elicitation`` is False, these pre-fill the interactive form. When True, they are sent directly to the API. |
| `required_fields_only` | `boolean` | `false` | If True, only elicit required fields. Default: False. |
| `skip_elicitation` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, bypass interactive elicitation and send ``fields`` directly to the API. Recommended for AI agent workflows. |
| `phase_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional target phase ID. Interactive elicitation prompts start-form fields (matching the Pipefy UI); phase field values are merged from ``fields`` when provided. For agent seeding, set ``skip_elicitation=true``. Discover via: ``get_pipe(pipe_id).phases[].id``. |

### `create_card_relation`

Connect a child card to a parent card using an existing pipe relation.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parent_id` | `string` | required | Parent card ID. Discover via: ``find_cards`` or ``get_cards(pipe_id)``. |
| `child_id` | `string` | required | Child card ID. Discover via: ``find_cards`` or ``get_cards(pipe_id)``. |
| `source_id` | `string` | required | Pipe relation ID that defines the parent/child pipe link. Discover via: ``get_pipe_relations(pipe_id)[].id``. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Optional ``CreateCardRelationInput`` fields (camelCase), e.g. ``sourceType`` (default ``PipeRelation``). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `create_field_condition`

Create a conditional field rule (Pipefy ``createFieldCondition``).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase_id` | `string` | required | Phase ID that owns the condition (``phaseId`` on the API input). Discover via: ``get_pipe(pipe_id)`` then inspect ``phases[].id``. |
| `condition` | `object` | required | ``ConditionInput`` dict. Must include ``expressions`` (list of expression objects with ``structure_id``, ``field_address``, ``operation``, ``value``) and ``expressions_structure`` (array of arrays of ``structure_id`` values). Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].internal_id`` for ``field_address``. |
| `actions` | `array of object` | required | List of ``FieldConditionActionInput`` dicts; each needs ``phaseFieldId``. ``phaseFieldId`` is usually the field's ``internal_id`` from ``get_phase_fields``, same pattern as ``fill_card_phase_fields`` and ``create_card_relation``. Each action must include ``actionId`` (``hide`` or ``show``); legacy ``hidden`` is mapped to ``hide``. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Rule display name. Required by the API; may also be provided via ``extra_input={"name": ...}`` for back-compat. |
| `extra_input` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional extra keys for ``createFieldConditionInput`` (e.g. ``index``). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `create_phase`

Create a phase in a pipe.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Pipe that will contain the phase. |
| `name` | `string` | required | Phase name. |
| `done` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, marks a final/done phase. |
| `index` | `number \| integer \| null` | `null` | Float sort key. A value between two existing keys inserts between those phases. Equal keys have no fixed order; use a key no other phase has. A new pipe's Inbox, Doing and Done keys are 1, 2 and 3, and 0 omits the phase from ``get_pipe`` phases. ``get_pipe`` returns each key as ``phases[].index``, in ascending order. Index only sets order - it does not configure Phase Connections / ``allowed_phases`` (UI-only); call ``get_phase_allowed_move_targets`` before moves. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional phase description. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `find_cards`

Find cards in the pipe where a specific custom field equals a given value.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | The ID of the pipe to search in. |
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Pipefy field slug (e.g. "status", "campaign_name") — the ``id`` value returned by get_start_form_fields or get_phase_fields, NOT the human-readable label and NOT pipe-report column names. Call get_phase_fields (per phase) or get_start_form_fields to discover valid slugs. |
| `field_value` | `string` | required | Value to match for that field (string; use the format expected by the field type). |
| `include_fields` | `boolean` | `false` | If True, include each card's custom fields (name, value) in the response. |
| `first` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Max cards per page (optional). |
| `after` | `string \| null` | `null` | Cursor from ``pageInfo.endCursor`` for the next page (optional). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id on errors. |

|---|---|---|---|
| `card_id` | `string` | required | The ID of the card to update (required) |
| `title` | `string \| null` | `null` | New title for the card |
| `assignee_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | List of user IDs to assign (replaces existing) |
| `label_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | List of label IDs to associate (replaces existing) |
| `due_date` | `string \| null` | `null` | New due date in ISO 8601 format |
| `field_updates` | `array of object \| null` | `null` | List of field update objects: - field_id (str): The field ID to update - value (any): The value(s) to set - operation (str, optional): "ADD", "REMOVE", or "REPLACE" (default) |

### `update_card_field`

Update a single field of a card.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `card_id` | `string` | required | The ID of the card containing the field to update. Discover via: ``find_cards`` or ``get_cards(pipe_id)``. |
| `field_id` | `string` | required | The ID (slug) of the field to update. Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].id`` (or ``internal_id`` for numeric forms). |
| `new_value` | `any` | required | The new value for the field (string, number, list, etc.) |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id on errors. |

Update an existing comment by its ID.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `text` | `string` | required | The new comment text (1-1000 characters). |

### `update_field_condition`

Update an existing field condition.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `condition_id` | `string` | required | Field condition ID to update. Discover via: ``get_field_conditions(phase_id)[].id``. |
| `condition` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional ``ConditionInput`` dict (same as create). Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].internal_id`` for ``field_address``. |
| `actions` | `array of object \| null` | `null` | Optional list of ``FieldConditionActionInput`` dicts (same as create). Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].internal_id`` for ``phaseFieldId``. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional new rule name. |
| `extra_input` | `object \| null` | `null` | Additional fields to merge into ``UpdateFieldConditionInput``. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

Update a pipe label.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label_id` | `string` | required | Label ID to update. |
| `name` | `string` | required | New label name (non-empty). |
| `color` | `string` | required | New label color as hex ``#RGB`` or ``#RRGGBB`` (e.g. ``#F00``); color names are rejected before GraphQL. |
| `extra_input` | `object \| null` | `null` | Additional UpdateLabelInput fields, if any. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_phase`

Update a phase.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase_id` | `string` | required | Phase ID to update. Discover via: ``get_pipe(pipe_id).phases[].id``. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | New name, if changing. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description, if changing. |
| `done` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Whether the phase is a final phase, if changing. |
| `color` | `string \| null` | `null` | Phase color (API enum), if changing. |
| `lateness_time` | `integer \| null` | `null` | SLA in seconds, if changing. |
| `can_receive_card_directly_from_draft` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | If changing. |
| `only_admin_can_move_to_previous` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | If changing (deprecated in API). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_phase_field`

Update a phase field.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Field slug (from create_phase_field or get_phase_fields). Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].id`` (or ``uuid`` for disambiguation). |
| `label` | `string` | required | Field label (required by the Pipefy API even if unchanged — pass the current value). |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description, if changing. |
| `required` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Whether the field is required, if changing. |
| `options` | `array \| object \| null` | `null` | Field options list (e.g. ["Alta", "Média", "Baixa"] for select fields). |
| `uuid` | `string \| null` | `null` | Field UUID for disambiguation when the slug exists on multiple phases. Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].uuid``. |
| `phase_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | When set (without ``uuid``), narrows slug resolution to that phase's fields. |
| `pipe_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | When set (without ``uuid``), resolves a slug across the whole pipe (start form + phases). |
| `extra_input` | `object \| null` | `null` | Additional UpdatePhaseFieldInput fields, if any. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

| `color` | `string \| null` | `null` | Color enum/string per API, if changing. |

| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_pipe_relation`

Update an existing pipe relation (name, auto-fill, connection flags).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `name` | `string` | required | New relation name (required by the API). |

| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `upload_attachment_to_card`

Upload one file to a card attachment field (presigned URL, S3 PUT, then updateCardField).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

## database

Pipefy database tables: tables, table fields, table relations, records, and record attachments.

### `create_table`

Create a new database table in an organization.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Table name. |
| `organization_id` | `string` | required | Owning organization ID. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Additional `CreateTableInput` fields (e.g. description, authorization). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `create_table_field`

Add a column (field) to a database table schema.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Database table ID. Discover via: ``search_tables`` or ``get_tables(table_ids)``. |
| `label` | `string` | required | Field label in the UI. |
| `field_type` | `string` | required | Pipefy field type string (API input key `type`). See common types above. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Additional CreateTableFieldInput keys to merge (e.g. required, options). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `create_table_record`

Create a row in a database table with field values.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Target table ID. Discover via: ``search_tables`` or ``get_tables(table_ids)``. |
| `fields` | `any` | required | Map of field_id -> value, or list of objects with field_id / field_value. Discover via: ``get_table(table_id).table_fields[].id``. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional record title. Pipefy may derive or override the stored title from the first table field (for example a select/status column), so the returned ``title`` can differ from the value you pass here. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Other `CreateTableRecordInput` keys (e.g. label_ids). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `delete_table`

Delete a database table permanently.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Table ID to delete. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | When True with the preview token, performs the deletion. |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `delete_table_field`

Delete a database table field (column) permanently.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Table field ID to delete. |
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Table ID containing this field (required by the Pipefy API). |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `delete_table_record`

Delete a table record permanently.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | `string` | required | Record ID to delete. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `find_records`

Search records in a database table where a field matches a value.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Database table ID. |
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Field ID to filter on (from table metadata). |
| `field_value` | `string` | required | Value to match (string; format depends on field type). |
| `first` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Optional page size for pagination (1-200 when set). |
| `after` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional cursor from ``pagination.end_cursor`` of a prior response. |

### `get_table`

Load one database table: name, description, fields, and authorization.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Pipefy database table ID. |

### `get_table_record`

Load a single database table record with its field values.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | `string` | required | Table record ID (string or positive integer). |

### `get_table_records`

List records in a database table using cursor pagination.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Database table ID. |
| `first` | `integer` | `50` | Page size (1–200, default 50). |
| `after` | `string \| null` | `null` | Cursor from the previous page (`endCursor`), if any. |

### `get_table_relations`

Load table relations by ID (Pipefy root ``table_relations``).

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `relation_ids` | `array of string` | required | Non-empty list of **table relation** IDs (never the database table ID). |

### `get_tables`

Load several database tables by ID (same shape as get_table per table).

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_ids` | `array of string` | required | Non-empty list of table IDs. |

### `search_tables`

Search for all accessible databases (tables) across all organizations.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional table name to search for (case-insensitive partial match). |
| `first` | `integer` | `100` | GraphQL ``tables(first: ...)`` per organization (1-500). |

### `set_table_record_field_value`

Update a single custom field on a table record.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | `string` | required | Record ID. Discover via: ``find_records(table_id, field_id, field_value)`` or ``get_table_records(table_id)[].id``. |
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Table field ID. Discover via: ``get_table(table_id).table_fields[].id``. |
| `value` | `any` | required | New value (string/number/list as required by the field type). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_table`

Update database table attributes (name, description, or other `UpdateTableInput` fields).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_id` | `string` | required | Table ID to update. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | New name, if changing. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description, if changing. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Other `UpdateTableInput` keys to merge (e.g. public, icon). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_table_field`

Update a database table field (schema column).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Table field ID (slug string or positive integer). |
| `table_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Table ID containing this field (required by API). If not provided, can be passed via extra_input. |
| `label` | `string \| null` | `null` | New label, if changing. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description, if changing. |
| `required` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Whether the field is required, if changing. |
| `options` | `array \| object \| null` | `null` | Field options structure, if changing. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Other UpdateTableFieldInput keys to merge (e.g. table_id if not provided as parameter). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_table_record`

Update a table record (title, due_date, status_id per Pipefy `UpdateTableRecordInput`).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | `string` | required | Record ID. Discover via: ``find_records(table_id, field_id, field_value)`` or ``get_table_records(table_id)[].id``. |
| `fields` | `object` | required | Keys may include title, due_date, status_id (or statusId). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `upload_attachment_to_table_record`

Upload one file to a table record attachment field (presigned URL, S3 PUT, setTableRecordFieldValue).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | `string` | required | Pipefy organization id. Use ``get_organization`` or ``get_pipe`` to find it. |
| `table_record_id` | `string` | required | Database table record id. |
| `field_id` | `string` | required | Attachment field slug on the table record (e.g. "document_upload"), not the uuid. |
| `file_path` | `string \| null` | `null` | Local filesystem path. Supports ``~`` expansion. Local profile only. |
| `file_url` | `string \| null` | `null` | HTTPS URL to download from (http only if the deployment enables insecure URLs); max 100 MiB. Required on the hosted server. |
| `file_name` | `string \| null` | `null` | File name including extension. Optional; defaults to the source basename. |
| `content_type` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional MIME type for storage. |

## interfaces

No-code page building: portals, pages, elements, and sub-portals.

### `create_portal`

Create or fetch the organization's main portal (idempotent).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_uuid` | `string` | required | Organization UUID, or numeric organization id. |

### `create_portal_element`

Create a portal page element (portal "tool" / widget in the Pipefy UI).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page_id` | `string` | required | Parent page UUID. |
| `type` | `"text" \| "table" \| "field" \| "embedLink" \| "embedVideo" \| "embedImage" \| "button" \| "divider" \| "link" \| "forms" \| "pages" \| "subPortal" \| "automationButton" \| "contentBlock" \| "document"` | required | ``InterfacePageElementType`` value (e.g. ``forms``, ``link``). |
| `metadata` | `object` | required | Element metadata JSON (shape depends on ``type``). |
| `data_sources` | `array of object \| null` | `null` | Optional data source bindings for ``forms`` elements. |
| `element_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional client-provided element UUID. Required with ``layout`` so a row can reference the new element. |
| `editable` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Optional editable flag. |
| `layout` | `array of object \| null` | `null` | Optional full page layout row array (``id``, ``type: "row"``, ``children``). Each row needs a non-empty id, type "row", and children as non-empty strings. Preserve every existing row; never send an object wrapper. The API stores this JSON verbatim, so an incomplete row replaces the page grid and is rejected. |

### `create_portal_page`

Create a portal page on the Interfaces schema.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `portal_uuid` | `string` | required | Parent portal interface UUID. |
| `title` | `string` | required | Page title. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional page description. |
| `index` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Optional sort index. |

### `create_sub_portal`

Create a sub-portal under a main portal (Interfaces API).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main_portal_uuid` | `string` | required | Parent main portal interface UUID. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional display name. |

### `delete_portal`

Delete a portal interface (irreversible).

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `portal_uuid` | `string` | required | Portal interface UUID to delete. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |

### `delete_portal_element`

Delete a portal page element (irreversible).

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `element_id` | `string` | required | Element UUID to delete. |
| `page_id` | `string` | required | Parent page UUID. |
| `layout` | `array of object \| null` | `null` | Optional full page layout row array with ``element_id`` removed. Each row needs a non-empty id, type "row", and children as non-empty strings; a row still listing ``element_id`` is rejected. Send the same rows on both steps. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |

### `delete_portal_page`

Delete a portal page (irreversible).

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `portal_uuid` | `string` | required | Parent portal interface UUID. |
| `page_id` | `string` | required | Page UUID to delete. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |

Delete a sub-portal entity (irreversible).

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the detach (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |

| `type` | `"text" \| "table" \| "field" \| "embedLink" \| "embedVideo" \| "embedImage" \| "button" \| "divider" \| "link" \| "forms" \| "pages" \| "subPortal" \| "automationButton" \| "contentBlock" \| "document"` | required | Element type for metadata validation. |

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `portal_uuid` | `string` | required | Parent portal interface UUID. |

| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional new description. |
| `index` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Optional sort index. |

### `update_portal_page_layout`

Update a portal page grid layout.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page_id` | `string` | required | Page UUID. |
| `layout` | `array of object` | required | Full array from get_portal -> pages[].layout. Each row needs a non-empty id, type "row", and children as non-empty strings. [] is an empty page. Preserve row IDs and children, changing only intended positions. Do not wrap it in an object or infer positions from metadata.gridMap (element dimensions). An incomplete row is rejected because the API stores this JSON verbatim. Re-read to verify. |

| `sub_portal_uuid` | `string` | required | Sub-portal UUID to attach. |

## automation

Pipefy-native rule (if/then) and AI automations, plus their execution logs, metrics, usage, and job exports.

### `create_ai_automation`

Create a simple AI automation that generates content with a prompt and writes the result to one or more card fields.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Automation name. |
| `event_id` | `string` | required | Event trigger (e.g. card_created, card_moved). Discover via: ``get_automation_events(pipe_id)``. |
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Pipe ID where the automation runs. Discover via: ``search_pipes`` or ``get_organization``. |
| `prompt` | `string` | required | AI prompt text. MUST reference at least one pipe field using %{internal_id} syntax (e.g. "Summarize the brief: %{900000101}"). The digits are illustrative — substitute each field's numeric internal_id from get_phase_fields / get_start_form_fields. Without a field reference the API rejects the request. Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].internal_id`` for ``%{internal_id}`` tokens. |
| `field_ids` | `array of string` | required | List of field internal IDs where the AI writes its output. Discover via: ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)[].internal_id``. |
| `skills_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | AI skill IDs to attach. Defaults to empty (no skills). |
| `event_params` | `object \| null` | `null` | Trigger-specific filters (e.g. {"to_phase_id": "..."} for card_moved, {"triggerFieldIds": [...]} for field_updated). |
| `condition` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional trigger condition dict. Omit to use the built-in placeholder (empty expression list) so Pipefy always receives a condition on create. Pass a dict to set a custom condition. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL error codes and correlation_id to create failures. |

### `create_automation`

Create a traditional automation rule on a pipe (event + action).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Pipe ID where the trigger event fires (source pipe). |
| `name` | `string` | required | Rule name. |
| `trigger_id` | `string` | required | Event ID from ``get_automation_events``. |
| `action_id` | `string` | required | Action type ID from ``get_automation_actions``. |
| `active` | `boolean` | `true` | When True (default), the rule is created **enabled**. Set False to start disabled. If ``extra_input`` includes ``active``, that value wins. |
| `action_repo_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Pipe ID where the action executes (destination pipe). Defaults to ``pipe_id``. Required for cross-pipe actions. |
| `condition` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional typed trigger condition (see **Condition** above). Wins over ``extra_input.condition``. |
| `extra_input` | `any \| null` | `null` | Optional extra fields for the mutation input; top-level keys are snake_case (mirror ``get_automation`` output). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `create_send_task_automation`

Create a traditional automation that sends a task to recipients when a trigger fires on a pipe.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `event_id` | `string` | required | Trigger event ID (e.g. ``card_created``). |

| `recipients` | `string` | required | One or more e-mail addresses separated by commas. |
| `active` | `boolean` | `true` | When True (default), the rule is created enabled and will fire immediately. Set False to start disabled. |
| `event_params` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional trigger filter payload (camelCase/snake_case as returned by catalog tools). |
| `condition` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional condition expressions payload. |

### `get_automation_execution_metrics`

Get execution metrics (totalRuns, successRate, failureRate, averageDuration, lastRun) for one or more automations over a rolling window. Returns metrics for the automations you can access plus a `partial_errors` list naming any that were denied; a partial result, not a hard failure. Paginated: a page holds at most 50 automations; pass `page_info.endCursor` back as `after` to fetch the rest.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | `string` | required | Organization ID (numeric org id, same as in the Pipefy URL). |
| `automation_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Automation IDs to fetch. Omit to fetch every automation in the organization (optionally narrowed by the filters below); when provided, must be non-empty. |
| `repo_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional pipe/repo ID to scope the query. |
| `action_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Optional action IDs to filter by; when provided, must be non-empty. |
| `event_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional trigger event: card_moved, field_updated, card_created, scheduler, sla_based, card_left_phase, card_inbox_received_email, all_children_in_phase, http_response_received, manually_triggered. |
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Optional filter for enabled (true) or disabled (false) automations. |
| `search` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional free-text match on automation name. |
| `sort_by` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional sort field: created_at or name. |
| `sort_order` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional sort direction: asc or desc. |
| `period` | `string` | `"SIXTY_MINUTES"` | One of FIFTEEN_MINUTES, SIXTY_MINUTES (default), TWELVE_HOURS, TWENTY_FOUR_HOURS. |
| `first` | `integer` | `50` | Page size, 1 to 50 (default 50). |
| `after` | `string \| null` | `null` | Cursor from a previous page's page_info.endCursor. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to transport-level GraphQL errors. Top-level failures (unknown org, no org access) return a plain message; per-automation denials already carry correlation_id in partial_errors. |

### `get_automation_jobs_export`

Poll an automation jobs export by id. Returns `status` (`created`, `processing`, `finished`, `failed`) and `fileUrl` when the API provides a signed download link (often after `finished`). Use after `export_automation_jobs`; repeat until `finished` or `failed`. The tool does not download the file — use `fileUrl` over HTTP if needed.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `export_id` | `string` | required | Export id from `export_automation_jobs` result (`automationJobsExport.id`). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `get_automation_jobs_export_csv`

Download a finished automation-jobs export and return the first worksheet as CSV text for LLM consumption. The API provides an xlsx file which is converted to CSV automatically. Requires export ``status`` ``finished``. Only https URLs on ``*.pipefy.com`` from the API are fetched. Large exports are capped by ``max_output_chars`` and ``max_download_bytes``.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `export_id` | `string` | required | Export id from `export_automation_jobs` after the export is `finished`. |
| `max_output_chars` | `integer` | `400000` | Max CSV characters returned (256–2_000_000); default 400_000. |
| `max_download_bytes` | `integer` | `52428800` | Max xlsx size to download (4 KiB–80 MiB); default 50 MiB. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

## intelligence

AI capability: agents, LLM providers, knowledge bases, available models, and AI usage and credits.

### `create_ai_agent`

Create an AI Agent and configure it in one call (GraphQL create + update).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Agent display name. |
| `repo_uuid` | `string` | required | UUID of the pipe (from ``get_pipe``), not the numeric pipe ID. Discover via: ``search_pipes`` then ``get_pipe(pipe_id).uuid``. |
| `instruction` | `string` | required | Agent-level purpose (Pipefy UI "Description"; API ``instruction``). |
| `behaviors` | `array of object` | required | 1–5 behavior dicts. Each requires ``name``, ``event_id``, and ``actionParams.aiBehaviorParams`` with a non-empty ``actionsAttributes`` list. Optional: ``eventParams`` to filter event triggers (e.g. ``triggerFieldIds``, ``to_phase_id``). Optional: ``template_params`` / ``placeholders``, ``instruction_template``. See example above for the full shape. Discover via: ``get_automation_events(pipe_id)`` for ``event_id`` and ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)`` for ``triggerFieldIds`` / ``destinationPhaseId``. |
| `data_source_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Optional knowledge-source IDs (same as ``update_ai_agent``). |
| `active` | `boolean` | `true` | When True (default), create enabled. When False, create inactive by setting ``disabled_at`` (ISO-8601 UTC) on create and the chained update. |

### `create_ai_knowledge_base_data_lookup`

Create a pipe-scoped knowledge base data lookup: an agent data source that searches cards in a source pipe by conditions and returns selected fields. Requires manage_ai_agents on the pipe; run `validate_knowledge_base_access` first.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_uuid` | `string` | required | Pipe UUID (not the numeric ID) that owns the lookup. |
| `name` | `string` | required | Display name (required, non-blank). |
| `description` | `string` | required | Description (required, 1-900 characters). |
| `source_repo_id` | `string` | required | Numeric ID of the source pipe to look up data from. |
| `output_fields` | `array of string` | required | Field IDs whose values matching records return (1-30). |
| `conditions` | `array of object` | required | Condition objects (at least one), e.g. `{"field": "customer_email", "operator": "eq", "usingFillWithAi": true, "inputName": "Customer email", "inputType": "text", "inputDescription": "The customer's email address"}`. |
| `search_query` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional backend-defined search mode marker; leave unset unless you know the backend value you need. |

| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `update_ai_agent`

Update an AI Agent: replaces the entire config.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | `string` | required | UUID of the agent to update. Discover via: ``get_ai_agents(repo_uuid)[].uuid``. |
| `name` | `string` | required | Agent display name. |
| `repo_uuid` | `string` | required | UUID of the pipe (from ``get_pipe``). Discover via: ``search_pipes`` then ``get_pipe(pipe_id).uuid``. |
| `instruction` | `string` | required | Agent-level purpose (Pipefy UI "Description"; API ``instruction``). |
| `behaviors` | `array of object` | required | 1–5 behavior dicts. Same shape as ``create_ai_agent``: each needs ``name``, ``event_id``, and ``actionParams.aiBehaviorParams.actionsAttributes``. Accepts both ``snake_case`` and ``camelCase`` keys. Optional: ``template_params`` / ``placeholders`` and ``instruction_template`` (same interpolation as ``create_ai_agent``). Discover via: ``get_automation_events(pipe_id)`` and ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)``. |
| `data_source_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Optional list of data source IDs. Omit to keep the agent's current knowledge bases; pass ``[]`` to detach them all. |
| `disabled_at` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional ISO-8601 ``disabledAt`` from ``get_ai_agent``. Pass through to skip the preserve re-read and avoid a toggle race. Omit to let the SDK preserve. |

### `update_ai_knowledge_base_data_lookup`

Update a knowledge base data lookup by replacing its full definition. Requires manage_ai_agents; run `validate_knowledge_base_access` first.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data_lookup_id` | `string` | required | Data lookup ID to update (from `get_ai_knowledge_bases`). |
| `pipe_uuid` | `string` | required | Pipe UUID (not the numeric ID). |
| `source_repo_id` | `string` | required | Numeric ID of the source pipe (required; omitting it would strip the source from the stored definition). |
| `output_fields` | `array of string` | required | Field IDs whose values matching records return (1-30). |
| `conditions` | `array of object` | required | Condition objects (at least one) — the complete set, not a delta. |
| `search_query` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional backend-defined search mode marker; omitted means cleared. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | New name (non-blank when given). |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description (1-900 characters when given). |

### `update_ai_knowledge_base_document`

Update a knowledge base document's metadata. Requires manage_ai_agents; run `validate_knowledge_base_access` first.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | `string` | required | Document ID to update (from `get_ai_knowledge_bases`). |
| `pipe_uuid` | `string` | required | Pipe UUID (not the numeric ID). |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | New name (non-blank when given). |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description (1-900 characters when given). |

### `update_ai_knowledge_base_plain_text`

Update a pipe-scoped knowledge base plain text. Requires manage_ai_agents; run `validate_knowledge_base_access` first.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plain_text_id` | `string` | required | Plain text ID to update (from `get_ai_knowledge_bases`). |
| `pipe_uuid` | `string` | required | Pipe UUID (not the numeric ID). |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | New name (non-blank when given). |
| `content` | `string \| null` | `null` | New content (1-3500 characters when given). |
| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | New description (1-900 characters when given). |

### `update_llm_provider`

Update a custom (BYOM) LLM provider (full configuration replacement). Requires manage_ai_providers and an eligible plan; run `validate_llm_provider_access` first.

Flags: none.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `organization_uuid` | `string` | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID). |
| `configuration_file_path` | `string` | required | Local path to a JSON file holding the complete configuration object. Supports `~` expansion. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | New display name (optional; non-blank when given). |

### `validate_ai_agent_behaviors`

Dry-run validation of AI Agent behaviors against a pipe's fields, phases, and relations.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Numeric pipe ID (used to fetch fields, phases, and relations). Discover via: ``search_pipes`` or ``get_organization``. |
| `behaviors` | `array of object` | required | 1–5 behavior dicts (same shape as ``create_ai_agent``). Each must include ``name``, ``event_id`` (or ``eventId``), and ``actionParams`` with ``aiBehaviorParams`` (``instruction`` + ``actionsAttributes``). Discover via: ``get_automation_events(pipe_id)`` for ``event_id`` and ``get_start_form_fields(pipe_id)`` / ``get_phase_fields(phase_id)`` for ``fieldId`` values (slug or ``internal_id``). |
| `strict_unknown_action_types` | `boolean` | `true` | When ``True`` (default), unknown ``actionType`` values are reported in ``problems``. When ``False``, they appear in ``warnings`` only. |
| `data_source_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Optional agent-level knowledge base IDs to attach. These are unioned with each behavior's ``actionParams.aiBehaviorParams.dataSourceIds`` and checked against the pipe's knowledge bases (via ``get_ai_knowledge_bases``); unknown IDs produce **warnings** only (``valid`` stays true). If the knowledge base list cannot be read, a single warning is added and the membership check is skipped. Discover valid IDs via ``get_ai_knowledge_bases(pipe_uuid)``. |

### `validate_knowledge_base_access`

Probe whether the current credential can read a pipe's knowledge bases. A green result proves READ access only (read_ai_agents), never the manage_ai_agents entitlement knowledge base writes (plain text, document, data lookup) require.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_uuid` | `string` | required | Pipe UUID (not the numeric ID). |

### `validate_llm_provider_access`

Probe whether the current credential can read the organization's LLM providers. A green result proves READ access only, never write entitlement; provider mutations may still be denied.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_uuid` | `string` | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID). |

## governance

### `add_service_account_to_pipe`

Grant a service account membership on a pipe, by email.

| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | ID of the pipe. |

| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `create_service_account`

Create an organization service account (an OAuth2 machine identity).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_uuid` | `string` | required | The organization UUID (from `get_organization`). |
| `name` | `string` | required | Service account name (max 20 characters). |

| `description` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional description. |
| `expiration_unit` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional token-lifetime unit paired with `expiration_value`: 'seconds', 'minutes', 'hours', or 'days'. |
| `expiration_value` | `integer \| null` | `null` | Optional positive token lifetime (with `expiration_unit`). |
| `pipe_ids` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Optional pipes to add the new account to immediately. |
| `pipe_role` | `string` | `"admin"` | Pipe role to grant on `pipe_ids` (default 'admin'). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `delete_service_account`

Permanently delete an organization service account.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_uuid` | `string` | required | The organization UUID. |
| `service_account_uuid` | `string` | required | The service account UUID (from `create_service_account`). |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `export_pipe_audit_logs`

Trigger an async export of pipe audit logs. Returns `success: true` when the export job is queued. Unlike report exports, there is no export ID to poll -- the file is delivered to the requesting user.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_uuid` | `string` | required | Pipe UUID. |
| `search_term` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional filter on audit log content. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `get_organization`

Fetch Pipefy organization details by ID.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | `string` | required | Numeric organization ID. |

### `invite_members`

Invite one or more users to a pipe.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | ID of the pipe. |
| `members` | `array of object` | required | List of member dicts with `email` and `role_name`. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `list_organizations`

List the Pipefy organizations you can access.

Flags: read-only, remote.

Takes no parameters.

### `remove_member_from_pipe`

Permanently remove one or more users from a pipe.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | ID of the pipe. |
| `user_ids` | `array of string` | required | User ids to remove. Prefer numeric ``user.id`` from ``get_pipe_members``; a user UUID is also accepted. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the removal (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `set_role`

Set a member's role on a pipe.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | ID of the pipe. |
| `member_id` | `string` | required | User id of the member (not a membership row id). Discover via: ``get_pipe_members`` → ``user.id``. |
| `role_name` | `string` | required | New role name (e.g. 'member', 'admin'). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

## integration

Connecting to the outside: webhooks, iPaaS, and the raw GraphQL API (introspection and arbitrary execution).

### `call_ipaas_tool`

Invoke one iPaaS (Advanced Automations) tool in a pipe's workspace.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Numeric pipe ID whose iPaaS workspace to act on. |
| `tool_name` | `string` | required | Exact tool name from the ``get_ipaas_tools`` catalog. |
| `arguments` | `object \| null` | `null` | Arguments matching the tool's input schema. Omit for tools that take none. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to run a destructive catalog call (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response; echo it on step 2. |

### `create_ipaas_connection`

Create a connection (app credential) in a pipe's iPaaS workspace.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Numeric pipe ID whose iPaaS workspace to connect. |
| `piece_name` | `string` | required | Exact piece name the connection is for. |
| `connection_type` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token-mode auth type; omit in OAuth mode. |
| `value` | `object \| null` | `null` | Token-mode auth props; omit in OAuth mode. |
| `oauth` | `object \| null` | `null` | OAuth-mode payload; omit in token mode. |
| `display_name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Human-readable name shown in the workspace. |
| `external_id` | `string \| null` | `null` | Existing connection id to rotate; omit to create. |

### `create_webhook`

Register a webhook for pipe events.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | ID of the pipe. Discover via: ``search_pipes`` or ``get_organization``. |
| `url` | `string` | required | HTTPS URL to receive events. |
| `actions` | `array of string` | required | List of event action strings. |
| `extra_input` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional extra CreateWebhookInput fields (name, filters, headers). |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `delete_webhook`

Delete a webhook permanently.

Flags: destructive, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_id` | `string` | required | ID of the webhook to delete. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute the deletion (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `execute_graphql`

Run arbitrary GraphQL against Pipefy (queries or mutations).

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `string` | required | Full GraphQL document (query or mutation). |
| `variables` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional variable map for the operation. |
| `include_parsed` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, include ``data`` dict alongside ``result``. |
| `confirm` | `boolean` | `false` | Set to True with the preview token to execute a mutation (step 2). |
| `confirmation_token` | `string \| null` | `null` | Token from the preview response; echo it on step 2. |

### `get_ipaas_connection_auth_url`

Step 1 of connecting an OAuth-based app to a pipe's iPaaS workspace.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Numeric pipe ID whose iPaaS workspace to connect. |
| `piece_name` | `string` | required | Exact piece name (as returned by the catalog's piece-research tools). |

### `get_ipaas_tools`

List the iPaaS (Advanced Automations) tools available for a pipe.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | Numeric pipe ID whose iPaaS workspace to inspect. |
| `tool_name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Exact tool name to expand. Omit for the compact catalog. |

### `get_webhooks`

List webhooks configured on a pipe.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pipe_id` | `string` | required | ID of the pipe. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |

### `introspect_mutation`

Inspect a root GraphQL mutation: arguments and return type.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mutation_name` | `string` | required | Mutation field name on the Mutation type (e.g. createCard). |
| `max_depth` | `integer` | `1` | Levels of sub-types to resolve (1 = no recursion, 2+ = inline referenced types). |
| `include_parsed` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, include ``data`` dict alongside ``result``. |

### `introspect_query`

Inspect a root GraphQL query: arguments and return type.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_name` | `string` | required | Query field name on the Query type (e.g. pipe, organization). |
| `max_depth` | `integer` | `1` | Levels of sub-types to resolve (1 = no recursion, 2+ = inline referenced types). |
| `include_parsed` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, include ``data`` dict alongside ``result``. |

### `introspect_type`

Inspect a Pipefy GraphQL type: fields, inputFields, or enumValues.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type_name` | `string` | required | Schema type name exactly as defined (e.g. Card, Mutation). |
| `max_depth` | `integer` | `1` | Levels of sub-types to resolve (1 = no recursion, 2+ = inline referenced types). |
| `include_parsed` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, include ``data`` dict alongside ``result``. |

### `search_schema`

Search GraphQL schema types by keyword in name or description.

Flags: read-only, remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | `string` | required | Substring to find relevant types (e.g. pipe, card, automation). |
| `kind` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional filter by GraphQL type kind (e.g. OBJECT, INPUT_OBJECT, ENUM, SCALAR). |
| `include_parsed` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, include ``data`` dict alongside ``result``. |

### `update_webhook`

Update an existing webhook by ID.

Flags: remote.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_id` | `string` | required | ID of the webhook to update. Discover via: ``get_webhooks(pipe_id)[].id``. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional new display name. |
| `url` | `string \| null` | `null` | Optional new HTTPS callback URL. |
| `actions` | `array of string \| null` | `null` | Optional new list of event action strings (non-empty when provided). |
| `headers` | `object \| null` | `null` | Optional JSON object of custom HTTP headers for the webhook request. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | When True, append GraphQL codes and correlation_id to errors. |
